conclusions: The IBL-off GPU average was 5.2242 ms versus 5.2335 ms for the matched all-on return, a -0.0093 ms difference.
That difference is much smaller than the 0.1392 ms all-on run-to-run drift, so this pass does not resolve IBL's marginal top-level cost.
The absence of explicit IBL timers confirms the off state but does not estimate IBL work integrated into lighting shaders.
More repetitions or longer balanced A/B blocks are required before using IBL timing to rank presets.
